newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks down over two pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks down over two pct in late trade.

text.p: Jakarta's composite index was down over two percent in late trade on Tuesday as investors extended selling in banking stocks following the central bank's move to raise the rates for bilateral certificates (SBIs) of maturities between one week and three months, brokers said.
"The central bank's move had sparked selling, particularly in banking stocks, on perceptions that their earnings could be affected," a broker with a European securities firm said.

Alhtough the rupiah had strengthened in late trade on foreign buying the sharp fall in stocks was due to fluctuations in the currency market and concerns over the moves to tighten liquidity, he added.
The Jakarta composite index was down 13.34 points, or 2.23 percent, at 586.29 points at 0855 GMT.
